booking.metaDescription: Reserve with a $25 deposit. Non-refundable; applies to your visit.
booking.title: Book with deposit
booking.subtitle: A $25 deposit is required to reserve your appointment. Deposits are non-refundable.
booking.sandboxModeNotice: This payment is in Square test (sandbox) mode. Real credit cards are always declined—only Square test card numbers will work. To take real money, the site must use production App ID, Location, and access token with VITE_SQUARE_ENVIRONMENT=production, then be redeployed.
booking.policy: I understand the $25 deposit is non-refundable and applies toward my appointment.
booking.unlockPayment: Check the box above to unlock billing ZIP and card entry below.
booking.name: Full name
booking.billingPostalHelp: Must match the card. US cards: use 5 digits (ZIP). Sandbox test card: any valid US test ZIP if Square’s docs list one.

svcItem.paquetes: Special beauty & event packages (ask) — special prices

booking.cardFieldHint: This is Square’s Web Payments card field on your site (not the separate hosted “Square Checkout” page). The secure box usually only shows card number, expiry, and CVV. Your name and email are above; billing ZIP is the field right above this box. For some cards, Square also shows a ZIP inside the box after it recognizes the card.
booking.cardSandboxLuhn: If you see “Enter a valid card number” in test mode: use the full 16 digits (e.g. Visa 4111 1111 1111 1111), a future month/year, any 3-digit CVV, and a billing ZIP that matches (e.g. 94103). Incomplete numbers or real cards in sandbox will fail.
booking.noSlots: No open times showed in the online calendar for the next two weeks — enter your preferred time below to pay the deposit, or call us.
booking.slotsApiError: The online calendar isn’t available right now. Please call us to book, or try again later.
booking.preferredTimeHelp: We’ll confirm your visit by phone or message. Your deposit still holds your spot.
booking.squareConfigMissing: Payment form is not configured. Add VITE_SQUARE_APPLICATION_ID and VITE_SQUARE_LOCATION_ID to the site build, then redeploy.
booking.squareLoadError: Could not load payment form. Check your connection, sandbox vs production (VITE_SQUARE_ENVIRONMENT), and that the Application and Location IDs match that environment.
booking.squareLoadErrorDetail: {{detail}}. If this persists, open the browser console (F12) and confirm Vercel was rebuilt after changing VITE_ variables.

errors.terms: Please accept the deposit policy to continue.
errors.preferredTime: Please enter your preferred date and time.
errors.payment: Payment could not be completed. Try another card or call us.
errors.paymentDeclined: The bank declined this card (or the charge was not allowed). Try another card or use a different payment method. You can also call us to book.
errors.squareServiceError: We could not complete the connection to the payment system. Please try again in a few minutes, or call us to book.
errors.tokenizeClient: Square could not create a card token. In test mode, use 4111 1111 1111 1111, a future month/year, any 3-digit CVV, a 5-digit US billing ZIP, and match your Square sandbox app. In the Network tab, a 404 to product-information is a known sandbox quirk; the important line is card-nonce (400 = bad card or wrong app/location for sandbox).
errors.paymentWithCode: Payment could not be completed ({{code}}). Try another card or call us.
errors.unexpectedResponse: The booking server returned an invalid response (HTTP {{status}}). If you are the site owner, check Vercel function logs and that SQUARE_* env vars are set on the project.
errors.network: Could not reach this site’s booking API (our server, not Square). If the card step worked, check Vercel, VITE_API_BASE, and CORS. Otherwise fix the card error first.
errors.slotBlocked: That time is no longer available (the salon may have closed that day online). Please choose another slot or call us.
errors.slotTaken: That time was just taken by another booking. Please choose a different time or call us.

confirmed.metaDescription: Your deposit was received. We’ll see you at Eunice Beauty Salon.
confirmed.title: You’re all set
confirmed.body: Your deposit went through. We saved your contact details to Square and we’ll follow up by email if we need anything else.
confirmed.summaryTitle: What we have on your booking
confirmed.squareProfile: Your profile is linked in Square with this booking.

address: 1114 W Veterans Blvd, Palmview South, TX, United States

admin.title: Block dates online
admin.subtitle: Days you block here will not show as available in the public booking form. Use the password the site owner set on the server.
admin.notConfigured: This page is not set up on the server yet. Add ADMIN_PASSWORD to the API environment.
admin.loadError: Could not load the list. Check your connection and that the booking API (VITE_API_BASE / CORS) is correct.
admin.saveError: Could not save changes. Try again or check the server.
admin.saveErrorConfig: Could not save. If you are on Vercel, add Storage → Blob, set BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, redeploy, or use BLOCKED_DAYS in project env. Locally, ensure the API can create data/appointments.sqlite.
admin.blockNewHelp: Choose a date — all appointment slots that fall on that day in the salon’s time zone are hidden from online booking.
admin.noBlocked: No full days are blocked. Customers see the normal weekly hours.
admin.invalidDate: Check the date and try again.
admin.vercelStorageHint: On Vercel: Vercel → your project → Storage → Blob, create a store, then add BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN to the project and redeploy. The staff list saves to a tiny file in that store so booking and admin always match. Local dev: leave it unset; the app uses the SQLite file under data/.
